title: CANDLES
description:
DON'T GET CAUGHT
The demon goes hunting and will chase you, getting progressively more difficult as the game goes on. Use a combination of sprinting, walking, and resting to escape it.DISCOVER
Uncover helpful hints and character memories through notes and playable flashbacks.SEAL IT AWAY
Use your collected candles to perform a ritual and seal the demon away to survive.AUDIO AND SOUNDCANDLES has a carefully crafted original soundtrack with an emphasis on silence and tension. All sound effects in the game are original and compose a rich and unique sound palette to enhance the experience.
description_short: CANDLES is a top-down, atmospheric horror game where you collect candles scattered throughout a house to perform a sealing ritual on a demon before it gets to you first. Explore the house, find the candles, solve puzzles, and outmaneuver the demon to escape.
